description: Boundary-authorization registry for Yoma linkedGemaraLineIds. Each entry authorizes exactly one (daf, vilnaLine) Rashi entry to carry an empty linkedGemaraLineIds (a 'boundary' entry per audit_rashi_association.py's entry_category classification), with the specific reason, evidence classification, and source-relative boundary rule that justifies leaving it unlinked. Validated by validate_rashi_boundary_authorizations.py. Growth beyond the MAX_AUTHORIZED_ENTRIES ratchet in that validator requires an explicitly scoped docs-tooling PR that raises the ratchet.

entries.reason: Single-word stub comment ("Davar") whose own text explicitly marks it as a continuation ("stub continuation, continues on 5a"). The comment it begins is completed on daf 5a, not on 4b.
entries.boundaryRule: Cross-daf linkedGemaraLineIds are prohibited (see modules/yoma/scripts/validate_rashi_links.py). A Rashi comment whose underlying Gemara content is truncated at the daf's own final line and completes on the next daf has no valid same-daf target line, and must remain unlinked rather than be attached to the nearest same-daf line or to a nonexistent cross-daf id.

entries.reason: Part of one continuous Rashi comment (vilnaLine 46-64) explaining Rabbi Yaakov's distinction between the metzora's log-of-oil applications and the Yom Kippur blood applications (Leviticus 14 citations, Menachot 9a). The Gemara passage it explains is itself truncated at yoma-061a-l45b ("Rabbi Yochanan said:") and completes at yoma-061b-l01. No local (61a) Gemara line exists for this content.
